name: Photoroom
summary: AI photo editor for product images.

flows.title: Remove the background of a photo
steps: Upload a photo. Photoroom removes its background automatically.
Use the editor to make any further changes you want, such as adding text, graphics or shadows, or choosing a different background.
Select Download to save the result to your device. Enter a file name, choose the image file format, then select Download.
Select Home to leave the editor and keep the design in Photoroom.
